title: 干预涨幅全回吐：日元又回158，市场却不敢追空？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's also bring in our Bloomberg Chief Asia FX rate strategist, David Finity for more of this.
segments.zh: 我们请来彭博亚洲首席外汇策略师大卫·芬尼蒂，进一步分析。

segments.en: So, David, tell us, where is the yen hidden? Well, certainly, if you ask traders,
segments.zh: 大卫，日元目前处于什么位置？如果你问交易员，

segments.en: there's definitely no consensus at all.
segments.zh: 显然，目前完全没有共识。

segments.en: Obviously, what happened, we look at the plays early this week when, you know, Dolly and went down to 153.
segments.zh: 本周早些时候，美元兑日元跌至153，

segments.en: Certainly, hedge funds were quite happy to jump on that move with all the rhetoric coming out of U.S.
segments.zh: 对冲基金乐于跟随美国方面的言论顺势操作。

segments.en: from Scott Besson and Japan to make jump to that move. They cover those positions above 155.
segments.zh: 来自贝森和日本的消息推动他们行动，他们在155上方回补头寸。

segments.en: And now, basically, he said, we drifted back, we're back up here, we're at 158.
segments.zh: 现在，基本上，我们已回落，回到158。

segments.en: There's no real conviction at the moment because there's obviously still worries of will will be more intervention.
segments.zh: 目前缺乏真正的信心，因为显然仍担心会有更多干预。

segments.en: There's still the underlying trend of Dolly and higher that hasn't changed.
segments.zh: 美元兑日元的上行趋势仍未改变。

segments.en: And of course, you have U.S. pay rolls at the moment. So, if you look at the position that's going on, I was trending some traders yesterday, and one guy goes, look, the market's cautiously long, Dolly and.
segments.zh: 当然，还有美国非农数据。从持仓来看，我昨天与交易员交流，有人说市场谨慎做多美元兑日元。

segments.en: But he goes, there's no real conviction on this at all.
segments.zh: 但他表示，市场对此毫无信心。

segments.en: And you're sitting, you are seeing people play both ways, some people in options have done some downside trades or there's a bit of upside interest.
segments.zh: 你会看到人们双向操作，期权市场有人做空，也有人看涨。

segments.en: But a lot of people are just on the sidelines because they're going, look, let's just get Dolly, let's get pay rolls out of the way.
segments.zh: 但很多人选择观望，等待就业数据公布。

segments.en: See where Dolly and goes. Now, obviously, even if it's a strong pay roll data, some people are going, okay, rallies, but then does it rally back into intervention territory
segments.zh: 看看数据如何。即便数据强劲，有人会认为反弹，但反弹是否会触及干预区间？

segments.en: and then they come in on Friday and sell it down again.
segments.zh: 然后周五他们可能再次抛售。
